comparisons.peer_topic: Global Technology Scope and Product Portfolio
comparisons.peer_summary: Avago is a global technology leader designing semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, including AI networking, home connectivity, and software for mainframe and cloud platforms, while also offering fibre channel storage area networking products.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Avago describe their involvement in the enterprise and data center networking sector, but they focus on different layers of the technology stack. Intel emphasizes the shift toward software-defined networking and network function virtualization to provide 'efficient, cost-effective, and programmable platforms,' while Avago positions itself as a semiconductor and infrastructure software leader supplying 'AI networking and connectivity' hardware solutions. Intel's disclosure centers on the logical transformation of network architecture through software, whereas Avago's highlights the physical infrastructure and broad product portfolio serving these markets.

sentences.text: We are leading the world's shift to run networking workloads in software and create network function virtualization to provide our customers with more efficient, cost-effective, and programmable platforms that enable secure, agile, and reliable networking solutions from edge to cloud.

We offer thousands of products that are used in end products such as enterprise and data center networking, including artificial intelligence ("AI") networking and connectivity, home connectivity, set-top boxes, broadband access, telecommunication equipment, smartphones and base stations, data center servers and storage systems, factory automation, power generation and alternative energy systems, and electronic displays.

comparisons.peer_topic: Software Customer Base and Sales Channels
comparisons.peer_summary: Software customers are typically large enterprises with complex, multi-vendor environments. Solutions are sold directly, through resellers, distributors, hyperscale cloud providers, and VMware partners, with a focus on strengthening relationships and promoting an enterprise-wide license model.
comparisons.comparison: Intel and Avago both describe a customer base composed of large enterprises with complex IT environments, though their specific engagement strategies differ. Intel explicitly states it works with an 'ecosystem partners of over 500 network builders' to help enterprises optimize their networks, suggesting a partner-driven optimization model. In contrast, Avago describes its software customers generally as 'large enterprises that have computing environments from multiple vendors and are highly complex' and notes that solutions are sold through various channels including 'resellers, distributors, hyperscale cloud providers, and VMware partners,' highlighting a diversified distribution model for complex software solutions.

sentences.text: We work with our ecosystem partners of over 500 network builders to help enterprises optimize their networks with right-sized compute and connectivity requirements for current and future needs.
Our software customers generally consist of large enterprises that have computing environments from multiple vendors and are highly complex.

Our private cloud infrastructure suite of solutions are available directly from Broadcom, resellers and distributors, hyperscale cloud providers, value-added OEMs and VMware cloud service provider partners.
